## Astronomical 0.2.98
### Fixed - Only one Astronomical item shows in the menu bar. After updating to 0.2.97 with Launch at Login on, the menu-bar companion could start twice; a second copy now leaves at once. - Neural Engine prefill now engages. A model was unloaded as idle just as its Neural Engine programs finished preparing, so every message prepared them again; the idle timer now starts when preparation ends.
### Compatibility - macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon. - Installed models, chats and settings are preserved. The configuration format is unchanged.
The disk image is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled.
